quality_grader_1_items.notes: Two TestNG classes (LoginTest, CheckoutTest) with shared loadTestData/startBrowser/stopBrowser and clear scenario names, but no page-object sources are present and checkout is one long flow that repeats login. pom imports shaft-bom, depends on shaft-engine 10.4.20261013, and registers com.shaft.listeners.TestNGListener; logs show SHAFT JSON test data, properties config, and ReportManager navigate/type/click/assert with no raw Selenium. Shown locators use data-test (via xpath); no sleeps; SHAFT waits implied. URL, standard_user/secret_sauce, and expected strings live in sauceDemo.json and are loaded per test. No PMD/Checkstyle, no method bodies, no README or .gitignore; allure-results, allure-report, and multiple performanceReport JSON files are junk. Some asserts only check hidden=null.

quality_grader_2_items.notes: Visible evidence is pom, SHAFT properties, sauceDemo.json, and Allure/SHAFT logs; Java page/test sources, README, .gitignore, and PMD/Checkstyle output are absent (dump truncated), so those parts score 0. Design: LoginTest and CheckoutTest are separate and well named, and logs use named controls (Username, Login, Checkout) plus some raw data-test xpaths; no page classes are shown, and login steps run again inside checkout. SHAFT: shaft-bom/shaft-engine 10.4.20261013, TestNGListener, properties folder, JSON load via SHAFT, and only SHAFT ReportManager actions in the run; headless is true in custom.properties but false under properties/default, and a large unused default/cucumber scaffold is copied in. Robustness: locators that are printed are //*[@data-test=...], no Thread.sleep, waits are SHAFT assertion/engine waits; a few checks are hidden-attribute null==null. Test data: baseUrl, standard_user, secret_sauce, and expected copy live in sauceDemo.json and are loaded per test. Readability: method names are clear; checkout is one long flow; no static-analysis counts. Hygiene: allure-results, allure-report, and seven performanceReport JSON files are in the tree, with no README or .gitignore.
